title: Evaluation of the algorithm for the leading hospital emergency physicians for a Hospital Emergency Action Plan (HEAP)
summary: An algorithm based on a clinic emergency action plan for the management of mass casualties shall be tested in simulations and evaluated thereafter. The algorithm shall be optimised and improved based on this evaluation.
conditions: Physicians rate an algorithm as probands.

interventions.name: 15 mass casualty scenarios are presented to physicians for management and evaluation over 30 min.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Physician anaesthesiologists
Exclusion criteria:
Lack of informed consense
